codeQuality.verificationCommand: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
codeQuality.notes: TypeScript strict mode with zero any, oxlint 100% clean on 72 files with .oxlintrc.json and .pre-commit-config.yaml.

security.notes: Helmet strict CSP, CORS exact origin allowlist, body size capped to 16KB, IP rate limiting, input sanitization, OWASP Top 10 mapped, CWE-209 error masking.

efficiency.notes: Client gzip bundle size 89.44 kB JS + 8.30 kB CSS. LRU cache for geocode, air quality, weather, and AI responses.

testing.notes: 131 tests passing across 8 suites (engine, adapters, api, ai, rendering, dom, a11y, journey).

accessibility.notes: WCAG 2.2 AA compliant. Skip link, ARIA tablist/tab pattern, visible focus, risk never by color alone, text twins for SVG charts.

problemAlignment.notes: Strict adherence to Challenge 6: low-emission routines, indoor air hacks (Corsi-Rosenthal & HEPA CADR), commute mode comparison.
